goals.title: Project 1 - PM2.5 v2: air pollution and health, done properly (my dissertation, rebuilt)
goals.why: My MSc dissertation rebuilt the right way: one question the data can answer, honest methods, a real pipeline. My number-one interview story.
goals.celebration: Choose a treat and write it here.

tasks.title: Step 1a · Read my dissertation review + 3 papers on PM2.5 and heart / lung disease → 1-page background
Step 1b · PLAN.md: the question, the outcome, the unit (council area × year), what would prove me wrong, confounders - no code
Step 2a · Find the data: PM2.5, disease rates, deprivation per council area - source, link, years, licence (data/README.md)
Step 2b · Download script: every file into data/raw/ by code, not by hand
Step 3 · Look: shape, columns, years, area codes, missing values for each file
Step 4a · Clean each source: area-code changes, financial vs calendar years, units
Step 4b · Merge into one tidy table (area × year) and prove no rows were silently lost
Step 5a · Explore: plots + correlations (PM2.5 vs disease vs deprivation)
Step 5b · Model: predict-the-mean baseline → linear regression → random forest, split by area, with vs without PM2.5
Step 6 · Check: sanity checks, a second outcome or year, honest limitations
Step 7 · Report: README (question, data, method, results, figures, limitations, how to run) + requirements.txt
